decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the firm's established professional lighting markets and has only a website mention, suggesting it is below aspirations and resources would be better reallocated.
Medical examination light builds on the established offer and has its own page, so while results are uncertain, organisational slack allows keeping it for now.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires are close to existing industrial customers and presented as a multi-model line, likely meeting aspirations.
Designer task light is close to the established offer and a popular relaunch, so it is well above aspirations and low risk.
